title: The mutation figure recorded for NUM_PROXIES: an anonymous throttle budget keyed on an address the caller chooses
note: One mutation, and it is the delete rather than the usual edit: NUM_PROXIES is a declaration, so the only way to lose the behaviour is to stop declaring it, which is also the only way an operator's deployment silently loses it. `find` is hand-written from the committed blob and occurs exactly once; replay refuses otherwise. `claimed_count` is the figure measured on this tree by deleting the line and running the module, and the replay below re-derives it rather than restating it. Only the five settings subTests move, not the six behavioural ones: the keying table supplies its own NUM_PROXIES through override_settings, because what it pins is DRF's keying under a configured hop count, which is independent of what this repo declares - so the two halves fail separately, and a mutation that only rewired the throttle would be caught by the other half alone.

mutations.description: REST_FRAMEWORK declares no NUM_PROXIES, so DRF falls back to keying an anonymous throttle budget on the entire X-Forwarded-For header - a value the caller itself wrote - and behind a proxy every caller also shares the proxy's REMOTE_ADDR
